def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the first name in names readable inside the directory notes, or "" if none.

    Reads are confined to notes, subdirectories included. An unreadable or
    missing file is skipped, and no name can reach a file outside notes.
    """
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        for n in names:
            text = fs.read(n) else ""
            if text != "":
                return text
    return ""
